line_items.description: Ghost Pepper & Yuzu Crispy Chicken Wings

reasoning: Client hospitality dinner for one employee and two prospective clients from FinFlow Systems, so the €90-per-attendee dinner cap for 3 attendees is easily met by the post-deduction bill. The truffle screening of Figure 3 runs first in Chapter 2's fixed calculation order: the dry-aged ribeye with truffle butter is a main course at €42.00 per portion, at or above the €40.00 threshold, so the entire €84.00 line is deducted. The remaining non-alcoholic food and drink subtotal is €80.00, and the client-hospitality alcohol allowance in Figure 2 is 30% of that subtotal, i.e. €24.00; the Riesling and the Espresso Martinis total €84.50, so €60.50 of alcohol is deducted, allocated proportionally across the two lines (€12.50 on the wine, €11.50 on the cocktails). Germany's 20% tip cap in Chapter 14 allows the full €25.00 tip on the €248.50 pre-tip bill. The receipt is dated Friday, 18 October 2024 with a 21:42 time, a regular weekday before the late-night cutoff, so the weekend and late-night rules do not apply. Something was deducted but a positive amount remains, so the invoice is partially approved.
